snippet.title: LAN Party Adventures - Official Sandbox Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the LAN Party Adventures reveal trailer for this upcoming single-player adventure game merging storytelling and simulation that takes players back to the early 2000s. LAN Party Adventures will be available on PC via Steam in 2025.

In the golden age of massive LAN Parties, strong friendships, and dial-up internet, players will have to set up their own LANs, connect cables and peripherals, and solve the mystery of a friend who’s gone missing.

In LAN Party Adventures, players are tasked with setting up LAN parties in various locations and managing all the requirements. From handling the hardware to plugging the cables, setting up the software, and getting the computers to talk to each other. As players work to uncover the truth behind their friend's disappearance, they’ll need to collaborate with their group, solve puzzles, and follow digital clues. Each new LAN party brings fresh challenges to solve and pieces of the mystery to uncover, as well as a new opportunity to make them larger and funnier by unlocking upgrades and tools.
